model_annotation: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis displays the language families, ordered alphabetically from left to right: Baltic, Romance, Uralic, and isolate languages. The vertical axis represents the magnitude of the effect, scaled linearly, with tick marks at regular intervals ranging from 0 to approximately 0.5. Each bar corresponds to a language family and is colored gray; the bar for the Baltic family is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.45 on the vertical axis, while the bar for the Romance family is the shortest, at approximately 0.15. The bars are not sorted by height but are presented in alphabetical order as labeled. Error bars, which indicate the standard deviation, extend vertically from each bar, suggesting variability in the measured effect across the language families.
